HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
